plan.title: Saved eRFX draft hides Add T&Cs

steps.note: Open Events so the saved draft can be reached from the Drafts tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required for the saved draft.
Set the condition under test that should prevent the control from being offered.
Apply the remaining case configuration before opening the draft.
Confirm the events list rendered before switching tabs.
Show saved drafts, which is the source screen specified by the case.
Open an existing saved draft without creating or publishing a new event.
Assert that the Add T&Cs control is not offered on the saved eRFX draft.
